integrity: Analytical proof is stated with all quantifiers and conditions. Reproducibility script performs finite exact checks, not probabilistic or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: No uniform-in-m constants, leading tail coefficient, non-Gaussian extension, higher-row theorem, predictor-error bound, or closed-loop control guarantee.
scientific_scope: Fixed column count at least two; 2-by-m overlapping Hankel matrix from independent real or circular complex Gaussian samples. Two-sided least-singular-value small-ball exponents and exact negative-moment thresholds for pseudoinverse norm and condition number.
title: Sharp real–complex inverse-moment thresholds for two-row Gaussian Hankel matrices
